text: The use of a protein-A immuno-adsorption column may be con- sidered in the management of TTP associated with malignancy or bone marrow transplantation.3 Epoprostenol may be tried in order to inhibit platelet-endothelial interactions but again has not been subject to controlled studies; anecdotal evidence presents both favourable and negative results.9 Alteplase has been used successfully in one patient with HUS.10 Splenectomy may also be considered.1,3,4 1.
